# AdriaIntel

> Maritime intelligence and boutique data consulting for the global seafood industry. AdriaIntel combines traditional maritime expertise with analytics to help businesses navigate market complexity, transparency, and predictive modeling.

This site is the public marketing and insights presence for AdriaIntel. Primary content is in English. Article bodies are published from our CMS; use the articles index and RSS feed for the latest posts. For inquiries, email concierge@adriaintel.com.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.adriaintel.com/): Company overview, featured insights, and contact entry points
- [About](https://www.adriaintel.com/about/): Mission, origin story, and approach to seafood industry intelligence
- [Articles](https://www.adriaintel.com/articles/): Analysis and commentary on seafood markets and maritime data
- [Contact](https://www.adriaintel.com/contact/): Reach Mediterranean market and data specialists

## Machine-readable feeds

- [RSS](https://www.adriaintel.com/rss.xml): Full article feed for aggregators and assistants
- [Sitemap](https://www.adriaintel.com/sitemap.xml): All indexable URLs including individual articles

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://www.adriaintel.com/privacy/): How we handle personal data on this site
- [Terms of use](https://www.adriaintel.com/terms/): Site terms and conditions
